attchmntText: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited filed an investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 on 13th November 2026. The company reported Q2 FY27 revenue from operations of Rs. 329 crore, a 20.4% year-on-year increase. H1 FY27 revenue rose 16.3% to Rs. 675 crore. Q2 FY27 EBITDA reached Rs. 68.4 crore, up 182.1% year-on-year, with a margin of 20.8%. Profit after tax for Q2 was Rs. 56.3 crore, a 197.4% increase. H1 FY27 PAT stood at Rs. 88.3 crore, up 117.6%. Cash and cash equivalents grew to Rs. 551 crore as of 30th September 2026. The presentation was hosted on the company website.

attchmntText: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited approved standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026 at a board meeting on 12 November 2026. For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 32877.26 lakhs. Profit before tax stood at 7522.05 lakhs. Profit for the period was 5628.80 lakhs. Earnings per share was 11.33. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 67469.21 lakhs. Profit before tax was 11796.70 lakhs. Profit for the period was 8827.53 lakhs. Earnings per share was 17.77. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 114871.93 lakhs. Net cash from operating activities for the half year was 5416.07 lakhs. The results were reviewed by statutory auditor Rajesh Kapoor and Co.

attchmntText: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Chaman Lal Setia Exports Limited has announced a conference call for investors and analysts scheduled for Friday, 13th November, 2026, at 12:15 PM IST. The call will discuss the Q2 and H1FY27 financial performance. Mr. Rajeev Setia, Joint Managing Director and CFO, will represent the management team. Participants must register via the provided link to receive joining details. The meeting will be conducted over Zoom with ID 878 4245 0503 and passcode 108224. The event may be cancelled, rescheduled, or postponed due to unavoidable exigencies. The call will be recorded in compliance with SEBI regulations.
